html: If you think you or someone else is having a heart attack, call 911 right away. Do not drive yourself to the hospital. Fast treatment saves heart muscle.

• Chest pain, pressure or squeezing that lasts more than a few minutes or comes and goes
  • Pain or discomfort in the arms, back, neck, jaw or stomach
  • Shortness of breath
  • Cold sweat, nausea or lightheadedness
Women, older adults and people with diabetes may have less typical symptoms, such as unusual tiredness, shortness of breath or nausea without obvious chest pain.

• Manage blood pressure, cholesterol and blood sugar
  • Do not smoke
  • Stay active and eat a heart-healthy diet

title: Heart attack warning signs
abstract: Know the warning signs of a heart attack and what to do right away.
